question: In a reused, native-control-matched four-context source-record cohort, can fixed small response-only inverse learners acquire three known-pair tasks, and does limited replay retain earlier decisions after later tasks?
hypotheses: Measured modulus/hardness can support bounded inverse source-context recognition.
Four-hidden-unit NN may improve decisions over the linear and nearest-response comparators.
Replay may preserve earlier actually learned tasks; no benefit is assumed.
claim_limit: Reused exploratory source-record TaskIL, not blind TEST, physical IID, chemistry-only causal classification, complete physical profiles, dynamic forward-model-assisted CL, calibrated probabilities, or manufacturing validation.
